top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a mature, independently confirmed discovery arc: Holst on GLP-1 secretion and action in humans, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide and receptor biology, and Mojsov on the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide. Outcome trials in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease confirm the achievement. The citation names no single discoverer of the peptide, so the open priority question relative to the Habener group is not misattributed. Omitting Knudsen is a defensible choice of discovery over drug development. This is better than no award.
recusal_note: Documented co-authorship with Thomas Perlmann and a postdoctoral period with Paul Greengard; neither is linked to the credited laureates in P001, so no recusal issue is apparent.
